"""RoboPaint 花: camera-calibrated writing. All executed targets are saved in actions/.
Use the recorded manifest to inspect the trajectory; do not replay into this episode.
"""
import sys,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output');OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Q=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.]); SURFACE=.0202
class Writer:
 def __init__(self):
  self.r=Robot();self.obs=self.r.get_obs(cameras=[]);self.pos=np.array(self.obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10]);self.index=len(list((OUT/'actions').glob('*.npy'))) if (OUT/'actions').exists() else 0
 def run(self,xyz,note='',cams=['practice_cam']):
  xyz=np.asarray(xyz);a=np.c_[xyz,np.tile(Q,(len(xyz),1))];(OUT/'actions').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  for chunk in range(0,len(a),180):
   ac=a[chunk:chunk+180];idx=self.index;self.index+=1
   np.save(OUT/'actions'/f'{idx:04d}.npy',ac)
   res=self.r.submit('ee_pose',ac,dt=.05,cameras=cams,video='none',note=note)
   (OUT/'actions'/f'{idx:04d}.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta))
   self.pos=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10]);print(idx,note,'tip',self.pos,'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
   for c,im in res.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT/f'{c}.png')
   if res.stopped:raise RuntimeError('partial execution')
  return res
 def move(self,p,speed=.05,hold=.25,note='travel',cams=['practice_cam']):
  p=np.array(p);n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p-self.pos)/speed/.05)));a=np.linspace(self.pos,p,n+1)[1:];a=np.r_[a,np.tile(p,(int(hold/.05),1))];return self.run(a,note,cams)
 def dip(self):
  self.move([self.pos[0],self.pos[1],.09]);self.move([-.10,.153,.09]);self.move([-.10,.153,.022],speed=.035,hold=.5,note='dip ink');self.move([-.10,.153,.09],note='lift ink')
 def park(self):
  self.move([self.pos[0],self.pos[1],.09]);self.move([-.12,.23,.10],cams=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam'])
def main():
 w=Writer();w.dip()
 # horizontal practice lines, depth 1,2,4,6 mm; paper x [-.2136,.0136], y[-.2353,-.1359]
 for i,d in enumerate([.001,.002,.004,.006]):
  x=-.01-i*.040;y=-.150
  w.move([x,y,.055]);w.move([x,y,SURFACE-d],speed=.012,hold=.3,note=f'practice depth {d}')
  w.move([x,-.215,SURFACE-d],speed=.012,hold=.2,note='practice line');w.move([x,-.215,.06],speed=.025)
 w.park()
if __name__=='__main__':main()

from gen import *
class PreciseWriter(Writer):
 def run(self,xyz,note='',cams=['practice_cam']):
  xyz=np.asarray(xyz);n=len(xyz)
  # High accuracy IK, with linear interpolation between nearby solutions.
  q=np.array(self.obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:7]) if not hasattr(self,'seed') else self.seed
  qs=[];start=time.time()
  for p in xyz:
   sol=self.r.ik({'tip':[*p,*Q]},seed=q,tol_pos_m=0.000015,tol_rot_rad=.0001,max_iters=150)
   if not sol['ok']:raise RuntimeError(sol)
   q=np.array(sol['q']);qs.append(q)
  self.seed=q;qs=np.asarray(qs)
  # PD feed-forward measured on practice: approximately 0.1 s lag.
  vel=np.gradient(qs,axis=0) if len(qs)>1 else np.zeros_like(qs)
  commands=qs+1.8*vel
  (OUT/'actions').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  for chunk in range(0,n,180):
   ac=commands[chunk:chunk+180];idx=self.index;self.index+=1
   np.save(OUT/'actions'/f'{idx:04d}.npy',ac)
   np.save(OUT/'actions'/f'{idx:04d}_xyz.npy',xyz[chunk:chunk+180])
   res=self.r.submit('joint_position',ac,dt=.05,cameras=cams,video='none',note=note)
   (OUT/'actions'/f'{idx:04d}.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta))
   self.pos=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10]);self.obs=res
   print(idx,note,'tip',np.round(self.pos,6),'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),flush=True)
   for c,im in res.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT/f'{c}.png')
   if res.stopped:raise RuntimeError('partial execution')
  return res
